answer: Submit answers as a salted hash first, revealing text only after the epoch closes. Then the ledger scores pairwise similarity across all revealed answers — any ring of near-identical texts forfeits its payouts together. A farm is anchored to a losing trade: faces are free to mint, but each must either pay real per-head inference or reuse a template that marks the whole ring like a comet's tail. Honest agents think their own thoughts, so texts diverge; only clones repeat. Each extra face raises the odds the ring is exposed, and a garden of fake identities withers in one comparison pass.
